name: veriloop
description: Review agent-produced code changes and run a strict-blind, specification-grounded develop-review-fix loop.

interface.shortDescription: Strict-blind code review and repair loops
interface.longDescription: Review code changes across regression, performance, metered-service cost, readability, and repository conventions. Draft missing specifications, apply verified findings, and run a bounded develop-review-fix loop with unique blind reviewers and late-bound holdout gates.
defaultPrompt: Review the current diff before I commit it.
Draft a specification for this change before implementation.
Run a bounded review-and-fix loop for this specification.
